fire_when: A P0162 report calls a checked restriction identity or special-family inequality a proof of universal FEI without proving a suitable-coordinate input.
silent_when: A P0162 report says the selector obstruction is checked but the universal suitable-coordinate premise remains unproved.
text: Check the hardest universal input and its quantifier before saying FEI is solved. A KEEP on a restriction identity or explicit family leaves the parent conjecture open; see the named gap in the referee packet.
